title: Fusion | Bring Family, School and Clinical Observations into Review
software: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 · Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software · licensed for children aged 0–12
parentMoment: “It worked in the session. Why is it still hard outside?”
lifeDecision: Where did the skill work, what support was present, where did it not transfer and what should change next?
familyDiscussion: A professional explanation of what the different observations mean for the plan.
directAnswer: The BIS scope names a Clinical Tracking/Correction Fusion module. Pinnacle’s method describes activity ratings and relevant input from authorised roles. It helps people ask what is working and what to change; it is not automatic clinical correction without human oversight.
lifePurpose: A child’s progress should be understood in the places where the skill matters, including when it is not transferring as hoped.

illustrativeExample.title: A request works in therapy, but not yet in the school playground.
illustrativeExample.description: Illustrative example only. The child makes a request in a familiar room; outdoors, the same approach is hard to use.

steps.title: Notice the difference
steps.description: The family reports the setting, support and child’s response without blaming anyone.

steps.title: Bring relevant voices
steps.description: A therapist and, with consent, a teacher may add what they observed. Not every child needs every rater role.

steps.title: Review the reason
steps.description: The professional considers noise, timing, communication method, motivation and comfort.

steps.title: Correct the plan
steps.description: A different cue or environment may be tried, then checked again in real life.

illustrativeExample.status: Fictional explanatory example; not a patient story or observed result.

mechanism: Observations include context, not only a star or score.
Relevant people contribute through authorised, consent-aware roles.
The professional explains whether to continue, adapt, pause or refer.
limit: The source paper describes several possible rater roles; that does not mean six people observe every child. Individual records and ratings remain private.

questions.question: What is PinnacleAI Fusion?
questions.answer: Fusion is the named clinical tracking and correction module. It helps relevant observations return to the child-specific professional review.

questions.question: Does the system change therapy automatically?
questions.answer: The public description keeps people in charge. Professionals review the child’s response and explain appropriate changes with the family.

questions.question: Will school information be shared without permission?
questions.answer: School and other external observations should be shared only through appropriate consent and authorised roles.
